about:
Status Gruppe was founded in 2012 in Hampstead, New Hampshire, by Alpenwerk Performance Group, Inc., doing business as Status Gruppe. The company began from a realization that the aftermarket parts industry lacked a combination of quality and affordability, prompting the founders to develop parts that enthusiasts want at prices they are willing to pay.

Status Gruppe designs and sources a range of performance and styling components for BMW M models, including the F80/F82/F83 and G80/G82/G83 generations as well as the E46 M3. The product line covers exhaust systems, downpipes, carbon-fiber exterior parts (grilles, splitters, diffusers, trunk lids), suspension coilovers, forced-induction hardware, and drivetrain accessories. The company collaborates with external manufacturers to produce its designs and maintains inventory for fast shipping on stocked items.

The company serves the automotive aftermarket, targeting BMW enthusiasts and track-car builders. Its customers include individual owners of F8X and G8X M3/M4 models, E46 M3 owners, and shops looking for bolt-on performance upgrades. Testimonials on the site reference an E36 M3 track car fitted with an SRS coilover kit, an E46 M3 equipped with an SCZA exhaust system, and an E46 M3 with a carbon-fiber front spoiler.

Status Gruppe positions itself on delivering quality parts at affordable prices by closely monitoring its target markets and developing products that meet enthusiast demand at competitive price points.
